Cash or accounting? A revaluation gain or the translation of uncollected receivables differs from a real sale.

Dividends and Timing
The annual ordinary general meeting is held at most 4 months after the fiscal year; it approves the DPS.
Under the Commercial Code at least 10% of net profit is distributed, and payment is due within 8 months of the meeting at most.
On the reopening day the price is adjusted by the DPS; buying before the meeting just for the dividend gains nothing by itself.
Compare the payout ratio = DPS ÷ EPS with the projects’ needs and the major shareholder’s cash needs.
A high payout, paid at the last deadline and borrowed for = weak liquidity.
